verdict.rationale: The only export evidence is that clients can download their income statement, balance sheet and other reports anytime to share with others. There is also a QBO option where Bench works inside the customer's own QuickBooks account, so the data stays with the customer. Neither amounts to a documented full-data export in open formats. Missing for 10: full ledger/transaction export, documented open formats (CSV/JSON), receipts and documents bulk export, offboarding/account-closure data handoff, any API (OpenAPI probes 404), independent corroboration.
